_schema.note: Roster v0.6. All ability effects map onto the canonical effects.json glossary; conditional damage/hit-shape/pen/triggers live on ability fields (bonus_vs/hits/ignore_def/triggers), not in effects[]. 3 designed passives per unit; potency scales by rarity. Gold/Dark Legendaries carry an off-wheel sidegrade premium. Applied since v0.3: Doom removed in favour of debuff_bomb (v0.4); cooldowns reworked with slot 1 = 0 CD on all 100 units (v0.4); AoE vs single-target damage reweighted (v0.4); effects carry real magnitudes as {id,mag,dur,chance,stacks} (v0.5); every slot-1 ability deals damage, utility retained as riders (v0.6). Numbers are dials.

wheel.advantage_effect: +15% critRate and +15% pot on that action (per spec §7)
wheel.off_wheel_rule: majesty & mystery never take a wheel penalty vs the RGB triangle; they only have mutual advantage with each other.

reconcile_notes: baseStats hand-authored per unit (no shared anchor) — reconcile scale vs prototype before shipping.

rarity baseMult multiplies baseStats at load; pointsPerLevel feeds §4 allocation math. NOTE: with Legendary at 1.50x, keep the 'rarity = flexibility not relevance' pillar honest — Legendaries are meant to be flexible generalists; specialists intentionally kept Common (niche keys).
passives: 3/unit, unlocked-immediately for now; when the unlock mechanic is decided, flip the unlock/unlocked fields — no structural change needed.
passive.desc numbers scale by potency tier (common 5 / epic 12 / legendary 20, etc.) — dials.
effect_tags in abilities are a design vocabulary; combat engine implements a subset (feature backlog).

passives.rule: every unit has 3 passives; rarity sets potency ceiling, not count.
passives.unlock_status: PARKED — gating mechanic (milestone/capstone/investment) undecided; all passives set unlocked:true / unlock:'immediate' for now.
